CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 15
   D. 5

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

7. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 16

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
